newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - GCC called buy opportunity.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - GCC called buy opportunity.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns & Co said a recent drop in share price of Mexican cement producer Grupo Cementos de Chihuahua represents a buying opportunity.

-- The shares of GCC fell five percent on Friday and one percent more on Monday, which Bear Stearns said was apparently driven by rekindled fears regarding the potential negative implications to earnings of certain preliminary U.S. anti-dumping rulings released in late September.

-- "Changes in dumping duties are a key concern for GCC because of the significance of its export business; however, we believe that the record drop in share price represents a buying opportunity," analysts Sobani Warner and Daniel Altman said.
-- They said the share price performance overstates the true impact of the ruling, and the impact on GCC of the current round of industry price competition is very marginal.
